name: QuickDic
tagline: Offline dictionaries for dozens of language pairs
description:
QuickDic looks up words between two languages with no internet at all. Open its dictionary manager, download the language pairs you need once, and after that every search works on a plane, on a train, or abroad with no signal.

The dictionaries are built from Wiktionary, so instead of a single translation you often get several senses of a word. Results appear as you type, and you can keep as many dictionaries on the phone as you have room for.

Because the data comes from volunteer-written Wiktionary entries, coverage is uneven: big pairs are detailed, small ones can be thin. Remember to download the dictionaries you want before you travel.
